author: Zephyr I
title: BASE_SEED=42 — d=6 Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM + Late Time Inj. (exact match, AdamW+clip)
abstract: Direct comparison to no-time ablation (ID 384). Same config except we include late time injection. d=6, br=0.28, AdamW+clip, BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr/submissions')
from ray import tune
from double_step_time_core import create_network, create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
    }
